Name: Eldritch Fishing
Author: CozyPsychologist
Description:
The wizard has accidentally opened a portal to another reality and something came through....they are among you now.

Eldritch Fishing is a fishing expansion that introduces 40 new fish, 5 new cooked dishes, 4 new craftable potions, 5 new paintings, 2 rings that boost your power (at a cost) and 1 new fish tank to Stardew Valley. 

Meet a mysterious traveling merchant who sets up at the beach above the tide pools and sells various custom food, rings, paintings, potions, and recipes to make your own. He is there on odd-numbered days.  Use a new bait type exclusively sold by the merchant to catch the 4 new legendary fish and gather their mysterious gems to craft powerful potions. He also sells other various bits and bobs. 

[i]Does this mod use AI art?

No. All sprites are hand-drawn pixel art. Double Sprite Size (DSS) is purely a rendering framework — it tells the game how to display larger sprites. It has no AI component and does not touch the art itself. The mod author used AI for coding assistance only. [/i]

40 New Eldritch Fish

 4 Legendary Eldritch Fish

4 Quests that challenge you to catch some difficult fish

[b]***You need to install both files for this to work properly. The patch allows the Eldritch Bait to catch the 4 legendary fish. If you don't install the patch then you need to have a piece of the bait in your inventory in order to catch the 4 legendary fish.***[/b]

**This mod is safe to add mid-save and is compatible with SVE. It only adds fish to pelican town and ginger island so other mods will be fine.**
